_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil: no breaker in momentum, funding, or F&G, so the Disbelief rung holds until stress resolves into price or flows ignite a climb.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst is clear HOLD/Disbelief; narrative is silent on forward phase (cautionary tone only)
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d stays roughly -5% to +8% and F&G holds 45-65 with funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G under 40 with momentum under 40 and skew/netflow resolving into a downside break, or ETF flows plus momentum and F&G through 70
